newsitem.title: UK: London precious metals close mainly lower.
newsitem.headline: London precious metals close mainly lower.

text.p: GOLD - Closed at $339.30/$339.80 down 75 cent. Absorbed selling early and briefly topped $340.00 before profit-taking turned prices lower across the complex.
SILVER - Ended two cents lower at $4.92/$4.94.
PLATINUM - Off highs but up $1.00 at $354.50/$355.50.
PALLADIUM - Finished down $1.50 at $133.75/$134.75. Early fresh highs felled by fund profit-taking.
